# Glyptide

> Thoughtful text motion for generative interfaces — 96 patterns across 6 use cases. Model-independent presentation layer for AI streaming UIs.

Website: https://glyptide.vercel.app (home · playground · docs · For AI)

Glyptide animates and structures generated text. It does not call AI providers and requires no API keys.
The npm package `glyptide@0.1.0` is on the public registry:

## Start here (minimal context)

- [AI / integrator brief](https://glyptide.vercel.app/docs/ai-integrate.md): Install + integrate without reading website source — **fetch this first**
- Prefer progressive retrieval. Do **not** inspect `site/` playground source or engine internals unless maintaining the library.
- Do **not** load [llms-full.txt](https://glyptide.vercel.app/llms-full.txt) unless you need exhaustive pattern ids.

## Docs (on demand)

- [Getting started](https://glyptide.vercel.app/docs/getting-started.md): Install (local package) and first `createGlyptide` call
- [Public API](https://glyptide.vercel.app/docs/api.md): `createGlyptide`, instance methods, appearance lifecycle
- [Streaming](https://glyptide.vercel.app/docs/streaming.md): `append` / `pipeTextToGlyptide`, delta vs snapshot
- [Appearance](https://glyptide.vercel.app/docs/appearance.md): Presets, color modes, transient vs review-bound lifecycles
- [Patterns](https://glyptide.vercel.app/docs/patterns.md): All 96 pattern ids with lifecycle metadata
- [Accessibility](https://glyptide.vercel.app/docs/accessibility.md): Reduced motion, semantics, announcements
- [Design guidance](https://glyptide.vercel.app/docs/design.md): Motion and reading-comfort principles
- [Full documentation](https://glyptide.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): Consolidated AI-readable reference (large)

## Machine-readable

- [Pattern registry JSON](https://glyptide.vercel.app/registry/patterns.json): Versioned metadata for every pattern
- [Config JSON Schema](https://glyptide.vercel.app/schemas/config.json): Validate Glyptide configuration
- [Appearance JSON Schema](https://glyptide.vercel.app/schemas/appearance.json): Appearance options
- [Pattern meta schema](https://glyptide.vercel.app/schemas/pattern-meta.json): Registry entry shape
